node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

Adam was a very calm, collected, and carefree individual; speaking to Zeus in a very casual manner, much to the chagrin of the other gods present.
We later find out that Adam holds no grudge against heaven, despite the fact the Serpent assaulted Eve and then framed her when he was elsewhere, resulting in humanity's banishment from Eden. However, at the same time, he did not hesitate to kill the Serpent the moment he attacked them.

Adam loved Eve, so much so that he abandoned the paradise of Eden without a second thought when his wife was banished.

Adam displayed selflessness to the highest degree, pushing himself past his limits in his fight against a god to give humanity a bit of hope. Adam's love for his children was strong enough that, even in a battle for his life, he only thought of protecting humanity from anyone who'd try and do them harm. 

~!He was Humanity's representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ God, Human (formerly)
~!__Affiliation:__ Humanity!~

Buddha has an easygoing attitude and does not seem to take anything seriously. His confidence is great enough for him to challenge [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/140640/Zeus) to his face by claiming that the only one who can push him around in "all of heaven and Earth" is himself. Buddha also appears to have a sweet tooth as he was seen eating lollipops when walking and eating chocolates while relaxing.

Buddha also seems to display respect for other people by offering them foods he's currently eating, like when he didn't allow Zeus to steal one of his sweets, but offered his popcorn to [Brunhilde](https://anilist.co/character/140636/Brunhilde).

~!The human's representative for round 6!~

name.native: ジャック・ザ・リッパー

node.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity 

Jack the Ripper, or Jack, is an infamous serial killer hailing from late 19th century Britain.

Normally, Jack has the disposition of a typical British Gentlemen, accentuated by his sophisticated diction and actions. However, Jack is a true sadist and monster at heart, being considered by most to be a person shrouded in malice and evil, murdering people as he considers the fear they feel before death to be absolutely beautiful. ~!Jack the Ripper is Humanity's representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

Qin Shi Huang was the founder of the Qin Dynasty and the first emperor to unify China. His real name is Ying Zheng. Qin Shi Huang, also known as Shi Huang Di, literally means "First Emperor of Qin". He is widely regarded as the greatest Chinese emperor of all time despite sometimes being viewed as a tyrant.

__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.
Kojiro Sasaki's a famous swordsman from Japan, known as "History's Greatest Loser". ~!Kojiro Sasaki is Humanity's representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~
The God of destruction and one of the principal deities of Hinduism.

alternative: The God Most Trusted by the Gods

node.description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

He is the current God of the Underworld also known as Helheim.

Poseidon is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon as the God of the Seas.

~!Poseidon is the Gods' representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species__: God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Beelzebub is a prominent deity in the Philistine Pantheon and Abrahamic Pantheon. He is also the Lord of the Flies.
~!Beelzebub is the God's representative in the 8th round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Similar to Lü Bu, Thor is a battle maniac and takes great interest in fighting; especially with strong and/or worthy opponents. Furthermore, he only shows happiness and joy in combat, displaying his finest smile in the first round of Ragnarok. Thor is also a man of few words, not speaking unless absolutely necessary or when in combat. He often does not show this and has a more stoic and aloof expression on his face most of the time, making him seem unapproachable to others.

~!Thor is the Gods' representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

Heracles is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon. He is also one of the few divine beings, along with [Buddha](https://anilist.co/character/175945/Buddha) and the Valkyries, who are not in favor of ending Humanity.

~!Heracles is the Gods' representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

Nikola Tesla is a scientist just like his real-life counterpart. He doesn't believe in things like magic or gods, claiming they are just laws of Physics.

~!He is the 8th fighter for Humanity in the Ragnarok Tournament, and his volund is with the 9th Valkyrie sister, [Gondoul](https://anilist.co/character/386569/Gondul).!~
Messenger of the gods.

The Gods' representative in the eleventh round of Ragnarok.
He is a prominent deity in the Norse Pantheon, known as the God of Mischief.
Lü Bu, the Flying General was the strongest warrior of The Three Kingdoms. ~!Humanity's vanguard and representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity

Raiden Tameemon, born Tarōkochi Seki, is Humanity's representative in the fifth round of Ragnarok.

Göll described Raiden as the "incarnation of desire", being shown as a perverted and lustful man when around beautiful women. Despite this, he claims that he's always completely serious about any statement he makes.

Growing up as child, Raiden was viewed a monster by many other kids and became depressed, his mother would encourage him to use his strength for the good of the weak and always hugged him with love. From that day, Raiden took his mother's words to heart and used his strength to help the villagers around him. When the "Great Tenmei Famine" began, Raiden became saddened by the death and suffering occuring all over his village and so decided to become a sumo wrestler to raise money for his hometown.

It is said that Raiden has the strongest muscles in human history and was considered to be the best of all time.

__Species:__ Demigod

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During the Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

She's usually anxious and worried about many things to the point that it gets on Brunhilde's and Hrist's nerves. Whenever humanity's warriors die, she cries and mourns each of her sisters as they die with them.
As an apprentice valkyrie, she doesn't seem all that interested in saving humanity compared to worrying about her sisters.
Captain of the first unit of the Shinsengumi. ~!Souji Okita is Humanity's representative in the tenth round of Ragnarok.!~
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of beauty.

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts, breaking into a dance at the start of the second round of Ragnarok in front of everyone present, even being called the most shameful god by Hermes.

However, after several rounds of Ragnarok passed, Zeus became more humble, even acknowledging Humanity's strength. He is also extremely faithful and confident in those of the Greek Pantheon.

~!Zeus is the Gods' representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

~!Affiliation: Gods!~

The God of Misfortune.

~!He is also the fusion of the Seven Lucky Gods, being their original form before splitting up in the past.!~

~!The Gods' representative for round 6, taking the place of Bishamonten.!~

__Species__: Demigod

Hrist is the second of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Kojirou Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/140646/Kojirou-Sasaki) during the third round of Ragnarok.!~

Apollo is a prominent deity within the Greek Pantheon. He is known as the "Sun God" and is a part of the Twelve Gods of Olympus. 

~!Apollo is the Gods' representative in the ninth round of Ragnarok.!~
Supreme god of Nordic.

__Species:__ Demigod

Hlökk is the eleventh of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Jack the Ripper](https://anilist.co/character/159840/Jack-the-Ripper) during the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~
Chun Yan was the caretaker and bodyguard of [Qin Shi Huang](https://anilist.co/character/203633/Shihuang-Qin).
The watchman of the apocalypse.

name.native: ミシェル・ノストラダムス

node.description: Michel Nostradamus is a prophet, physician, fortune teller, and one of the Einherjar set to fight in a future match of Ragnarok. He is regarded as the prophet of the century and is also described as the “most obnoxious man in all of history”. After his death, due to the prophecy of the “Great King of Terror”, he came to be feared by the underworld as a “Major Threat to the Netherworld".

__Species__: Demigod

Reginleif is the seventh of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Adam](https://anilist.co/character/140637/Adam) during the second round of Ragnarok.!~
Ares is the 6th of the 12 Gods of Olympus and the Greek God of War.
Sakata Kintoki is one of the Einherjar.
Lilith was a Goddess that helped Beelzebub in his quest to find and kill Satan.
Muninn is one of the pair of ravens that accompany Odin.

alternative: Demon Lord of the Sixth Heaven

node.description:
__Species:__ Demon
~!Affiliation: Gods!~

Hajun is the legendary berserker of the Underworld (Helheim) and the Demon Lord of the Sixth Heaven.

~!Previously the God of Misfortune, Zerofuku. Hajun appeared when Zerofuku was devoured by two dragons, becoming the second representative for the Gods in the sixth round of Ragnarok.!~
Lucifer was an angel that once resided within Heaven. He was Beelzebub's first friend.
A Japanese swordsman and official of the late Edo period.
Marie Curie is a Polish physicist and chemist who conducted pioneering research on radioactivity.

__Species__: Demigod

Geirolul is the fifth of the 13 Valkyrie sisters.~!She forms a Völundr with [Leonidas](https://anilist.co/character/341135/Leonidas) during the ninth round of Ragnarok.!~
Susanoo is one of the Three Noble Gods. ~!He is the Gods' representative in the tenth round of Ragnarok.!~

alternative: The God Whose Existence Was Erased

node.description: Adamas is one of the original thirteen Olympian gods and the God of Conquest. He was the brother of Zeus, Poseidon, and Hades, descended from Kronos. After the Gigantomachy, Adamas attempted to overthrow the divine order by freeing the Titan race and the Gigantes who had been sealed away, and led them in rebellion against the gods. Because of this uprising, Poseidon executed him. Eventually, Adamas was revived and modified by Beelzebub under Hades’ orders.
Azazel was an angel that once resided within Heaven. He was Beelzebub's friend.

__Species:__ Demigod

Siegfried is a demigod who was imprisoned in Tartarus after Odin discovered that he was the Primordial Vessel, the key to the resurrection of the Four Primordial Gods. He is also the boyfriend of [Brunhilde](https://anilist.co/character/140636/Brunhilde).

name.native: アルベルト・アインシュタイン

node.description: Albert Einstein is a German physicist renowned as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.
Samael was an angel that once resided within Heaven. He was Beelzebub's friend.
Galileo Galilei is an Italian astronomer, physicist and engineer, who many regards as the Father of modern science.
Haggis was a Spartan soldier that followed [Leonidas](https://anilist.co/character/341135/Leonidas) into the Battle of Thermopylae.

Python is a serpent-like monster that was shunned by both the Gods and Humans for his appearance. It is said in legend that he was slain by [Apollo](https://anilist.co/character/321730/Apollo) but in actuality, Apollo befriended the serpent and was the only one who accepted him as being beautiful, not for his looks, but for his soul. Python would be the one to build the Temple of Apollo in Delphi, engraving it with the words, "Know Thyself."

__Species__: Demigod

Gondul is the ninth of the 13 Valkyrie sisters.~!She forms a Völundr with [Nikola Tesla](https://anilist.co/character/284632/Nikola-Tesla) during the eighth round of Ragnarok.!~

name.native: アルフレッド・ノーベル

node.description: Alfred Nobel is a Swedish chemist, engineer, inventor, businessman, and philanthropist. He is best known for the Nobel Prize, holding 355 patents in his lifetime and the invention of the dynamite.
Dane Tesla is the older brother of [Nikola Tesla](https://anilist.co/character/284632/Nikola-Tesla). He was a brilliant inventor in his own right.

Chi You is a demon god from ancient China who appears in various forms throughout early Chinese mythology and classical texts. He was revered as the God of War and as the inventor of the Five Bronze Weapons. In the ancient ritual tradition, only the emperor who had received the Mandate of Heaven was permitted to ascend the sacred mountain and perform the sealing rites dedicated to Chi You. In China, the right to be king had to be granted by Chi You himself. He was defeated by [Qin Shi Huang](https://anilist.co/character/203633/Shihuang-Qin) in 219 BC.

Flauros is a guard of Tartarus and the 64th demon of Solomon’s 72 Pillars. He serves in Helheim, within Tartarus, and is one of the jailers responsible for [Siegfried](https://anilist.co/character/368799/Siegfried).

Andras is a guard of Tartarus and the 63rd demon of Solomon’s 72 Pillars. He serves in Helheim, within Tartarus, and is one of the jailers responsible for [Siegfried](https://anilist.co/character/368799/Siegfried).
Bang Liu was the first emperor of the Former Han Dynasty.
Che Liu was the seventh emperor of the Former Han Dynasty.
Yuanzhang Zhu was the first emperor of the Ming Dynasty.
